The project includes:

- ADA-compliant restroom fixture set

| interior doors | 6 | each | $420.00 | $2,520.00 |
| restroom fixture set | 1 | each | $3,800.00 | $3,800.00 |
| 2x2 acoustic drop ceiling tiles | 2,500 | sq_ft | $2.40 | $6,000.00 |

**Assumptions:**
- The vanilla shell space is accessible and ready for interior construction

**Exclusions:**
- Building permit fees and related municipal charges
- Dental equipment, furniture, and medical furnishings
- Existing utility modifications or upgrades beyond standard connections

## Validity & Acceptance
